events.text:
The 24-hour cycle now runs end to end on my machine (a local preview, not production): the base and all 5 bug fixes passed the pre-merge check and came up healthy, the work is committed and pushed, and T-154 is back in review with Bharath and Adi.

| Item | State | Evidence from this run |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Start Docker, apply both patches, run the pre-merge check and the preview, check health | Done | On a copy of `development` f0b901e with both patches, the base passed `scripts/premerge.sh` in 134 s. Its preview answered `{"status":"ok"}` on `/health` 50 s after starting. |
| 1a. Fix anything that fails | Done | Four tests passed alone but failed when the full suite ran alongside Docker builds. I fixed all four in the test code only, no product code, and folded them into the red-suites patch. The last run had 0 failed suites on every branch. |
| 2. Pilot on the 5 fixes, timed | Done | Every fix passed the pre-merge check in 101 to 329 s and its preview answered ok in 51 to 54 s. Every preview was shut down afterwards. The timings table in `agentic-dev-cycle.md` is labelled "local preview, not production". |
| 3. The 5 fixes saved as patch files | Done | `fix_bug-1` to `fix_bug-5` were already in the patches folder. Each one applied cleanly to its own branch during the pilot. |
| 4. Evidence, dashboard, commit, push, review | Done | `test_dash.py` prints ok. http://localhost:8899/pipeline?v=1011c shows the local pilot table with all five fixes. Commit 03a4ec31 is pushed to `main`. |
| Ripple R-78b31135 | No change needed | The doc said nothing stale about empty Dogfooding or Tier bands. |
| Notes F-388c35de and R-78b31135 | Done | Both acknowledged. |

The board did not need a restart: it already served the new table.

Bharath still has to:
- apply the two setup patches and the five fix patches, then merge them;
- agree the review limits (product 2 h, code 4 h, QA 4 h).

The three metrics only fill with real figures once a fix is merged. The request-to-PR time still can't be measured, because the five bugs were logged to the day, not the second.

- `pipeline/local_pilot.json`
